notes: Primary contact: Claire Zhang (Head of Research Engineering) — heavy emphasis on reproducible search and audit trails.

Use-case summary: firmwide research portal that surfaces trading research, sell-side research, legal memos, and model notes. RAG flow: dense retrieval (embeddings) -> candidate reranking (neural pairwise) -> final passage aggregation.
Scale: initial index target 30M documents (PDF pages / snippets) with plan to scale to 120M+ over 12 months. Expect variable doc lengths (short snippets to full reports).
Latency/throughput targets: p50 < 40ms (embed serve + retrieval), p95 end-to-end query with reranker < 250ms for 95% of interactive queries; peak throughput ~500 qps for index queries across teams.

Cost sensitivity: looking for predictable cost per query. Target blended cost (embeddings + reranker + storage) < $0.015 per query for the majority of traffic; acceptable higher for deep research flows.

Model preferences: prefer an open/managed embedding model with support for dense vectors and optional 8-bit quantized reranker. Interested in Redwood's recommended embedding and reranker pairs; want ability to pin model versions.
Deployment ask: dedicated capacity in us-east with VPC egress, customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest and key rotation, audit logs retained for 7 years for compliance teams.
Quote from Claire: 'We cannot have token leakage — keys and residency are non-negotiable. Also need consistent latency on market open.'
Security review: completed initial questionnaire; awaiting KMS key policy changes and SOC2 artifact (Q3 copy). Security SME already engaged (meeting 2026-03-09).

POC scope: index 30M docs, run 72-hour soak with mixed query distribution (80% short retrievals, 20% deep rerank). Metrics: recall@10, reranker NDCG, p50/p95/p99 latency, cost per 1k queries, KV cache hit rates.
Ops ask: prefer canary rollout for reranker model updates; require per-route cost breakdowns and token-level billing for cost attribution across trading desks.
Internal notes: procurement wants line-item pricing for Dedicated reserved pool vs burst. Finance requested 12-month commitment scenarios (3 tiers).
SE notes: Diego filed preliminary infra diagram; plan: dedicated GPU pool for reranker (A100/RTX-class equiv), separate embedding service with autoscale but pinned to VPC.
Customer concerns: reranker GPU cost dominant; wants suggestions from Redwood Optimize on batching/quantization to meet cost target.
Next internal step: prepare POC runbook + acceptance criteria doc and share with Claire by 2026-03-15.
Potential blocker: if KMS MEC (key escrow) is not accepted, customer may request fully on-prem offering — increases timeline by 6+ weeks.
